description: Abstract class defining common functionality for building Spark command-line invocations, including classpath construction, environment setup, and configuration loading.

classes.name: AbstractCommandBuilder
classes.description: An abstract class providing common methods and properties for constructing Spark launcher commands, managing classpath, environment variables, and configuration files.

methods.name: buildCommand
methods.description: Abstract method to build the command to execute, given environment variables.

methods.name: buildJavaCommand
methods.description: Constructs the Java command with JVM options and classpath, including loading options from 'java-opts' file.

methods.name: addOptionString
methods.description: Adds JVM options parsed from a string to the command list.

methods.name: buildClassPath
methods.description: Builds the classpath list for the application, including Spark jars, project classes, and configuration directories.

methods.name: addToClassPath
methods.description: Helper to add entries to classpath set, handling directories and empty entries.

methods.name: isJarAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a jar with a specific prefix exists in a directory.

methods.name: getScalaVersion
methods.description: Determines the Scala version used for Spark build, defaulting to 2.13.

methods.name: getSparkHome
methods.description: Retrieves the Spark home directory from environment or system properties.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Fetches environment variable value from childEnv map or system environment.

methods.name: setPropertiesFile
methods.description: Sets the properties file path and invalidates cached effective configuration.

methods.name: getEffectiveConfig
methods.description: Returns the merged configuration map, loading and caching if necessary.

methods.name: loadPropertiesFile
methods.description: Loads properties from the specified file, including extra property files and defaults.

methods.name: loadPropertiesFile (private)
methods.description: Helper to load properties from a file.

methods.name: getConfDir
methods.description: Returns the configuration directory path, defaulting to 'conf' under Spark home.
